_note: Source: PARTNERS INVITATIONAL BROCHURE-2026.pdf (OneDrive, Partners Inv. Live Wall). CAUTION: the PGA WEST amenities page of that brochure uses a subset font whose ToUnicode table is incomplete, so extraction silently drops some digits. Hours and direct-dial numbers from THAT page were deliberately left out rather than guessed. Everything below came through cleanly. Verify before adding any number sourced from that page.
intro: La Quinta and Coachella Valley Area Guide.

items.label: Show your Partners Invitational ID
items.detail: Present it when you pay at PGA WEST and La Quinta Resort & Club outlets.

items.label: 20% off dining
items.detail: Excludes Peaks. The member discount is inclusive of price.

items.label: Golf shops
items.detail: 20% off soft goods, 10% off hard goods.

items.label: 20% off Spa La Quinta
items.detail: Spa and salon services.

items.label: 20% off retail
items.detail: La Quinta Resort & Club Plaza retail shops and Marketplace retail, plus soft goods at the Tennis Pro Shop.

items.label: Greg Norman Clubhouse
items.detail: 81-405 Kingston Heath. Wallabys WEST serves lunch 11 am to 3 pm.

items.label: Pete Dye Clubhouse
items.detail: 50200 Avenida Vista Bonita. Golf shop daily 6 am to 5 pm. Bunker Bar serves lunch 11 am to 3 pm.

items.label: Tournament Clubhouse
items.detail: Ernie's Bar & Grill. Grab and go breakfast from 6 am, full breakfast 7 am to 11 am, bar until 8 pm.

items.label: The Citrus Club
items.detail: Mandarina, La Quinta.

items.label: Private practice facility
items.detail: Open daily until dusk.

items.label: Fitness club
items.detail: Personal training by appointment.

items.label: Pickleball, tennis, and the swimming pool
items.detail: All on site.

items.label: Kennedy's
items.detail: Lunch, first come first served.

items.label: Hours and direct numbers
items.detail: Being confirmed with the club. Concierge at the main clubhouse number can help in the meantime.

items.label: Morgans in the Desert
items.detail: Dinner Wednesday through Sunday, 5:30 pm to 9 pm.

items.label: Twenty6
items.detail: Breakfast 7 am to 11 am.

items.label: Reservations
items.detail: La Quinta Resort & Club, 49-499 Eisenhower Drive. Also bookable on OpenTable.

items.label: Spa La Quinta
items.detail: At the resort, 49-499 Eisenhower Drive. Tuesday to Sunday, 9 am to 6 pm. Your Partners Invitational ID gets 20% off.

items.label: Agua Serena Spa
items.detail: Hyatt Regency Indian Wells, 44-600 Indian Wells Lane. Wednesday to Sunday, 9:30 am to 5 pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

items.label: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Rancho Mirage
items.detail: 68-900 Frank Sinatra Drive. Thursday to Monday, 8:30 am to 6 pm.

items.label: Old Town La Quinta
items.detail: 78100 Main Street. The closest option, and walkable once you are there.

items.label: The Gardens on El Paseo
items.detail: 73-545 El Paseo, Palm Desert. About 12 miles, 25 minutes.

items.label: Cabazon Outlets
items.detail: 48750 Seminole Drive, Cabazon. About 43 miles, 48 minutes.

items.label: La Quinta Cove to Lake Cahuilla
items.detail: The local favorite, and the closest to the resort.

items.label: The Bump and Grind
items.detail: A steady climb with valley views the whole way up.

items.label: Tahquitz Canyon Loop
items.detail: Palm Springs, with a waterfall at the turn.

items.label: Palm Springs Air Museum
items.detail: One of the world's largest collections of flyable WWII aircraft, plus Korea and Vietnam era planes. Air conditioned hangars, no ropes, and volunteers who will talk you through every aircraft.

items.label: Fantasy Balloon Flights
items.detail: Champagne balloon rides over the valley, daily September through May. $250 adults, $230 seniors, $175 children 12 and under.

items.label: Palm Springs Celebrity Tours
items.detail: The hideaway homes of Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., Bob Hope, and more. Private tours from $350 for one to three guests.

items.label: Red Jeep Tours
items.detail: Desert Adventures has run the valley's eco and adventure tours since 1988. Geology, history, canyons, and the big vistas.

items.label: Joshua Tree National Park
items.detail: Open year round, and October begins the busy season. Roughly 800,000 acres with very few facilities, which is the point. Hiking, climbing, photography, and quiet.

items.label: Pioneertown
items.detail: A former film set turned desert town. Pappy and Harriet's Pioneertown Palace is open Thursday to Monday, 5 pm to 11 pm. Nearby: the Pioneertown Mountain Preserve and La Copine Kitchen for brunch.
